title: After seeing what happened to GTA 6...
author: ChargeAdventurous751
selftext:
I urge anyone interested in making games to actually learn coding. Or we'll end up with woke games like this GTA 6 fiasco where you can't do anything like you used to. 

Anthropic and Openai are already obeying to their master (the government). And if you don't want to end up with bland games, completely restricted from any creativity or actual fun you need to make the effort.

Don't let the future become boring slop controlled by the normies.
